name: BOH Electronics
old_description: BOH Electronics is a premier cable and wire harness manufacturer. We offer custom cables, wire harness assemblies and wire processing solutions to customers in a variety of industries including OEM, Contract Manufacturing and all technology industries.
about:
BOH Electronics, a custom cable and wire harness manufacturer, is headquartered in River Falls, Wisconsin. The company was founded in 2005 by Ben Hanke, who started the business in his garage in nearby Hudson, Wisconsin, with a few customers and a goal of building a reliable manufacturing partner. After rapid growth, the operation moved to a 6,000-square-foot facility in 2006 and then to a 17,000-square-foot historic building in North Hudson in 2009, which underwent a certified historic rehabilitation completed in 2010. In July 2023, BOH relocated to a modern facility in the Whitetail Ridge Corporate Park in River Falls to support continued expansion.

The company produces custom cables, wire harness assemblies, and wire processing solutions, offering services that include design assistance, prototyping, electrical manufacturing, and electronic quality testing and inspection. Its product lines cover electronic wire harnesses, cable assemblies, wire processing, electromechanical assemblies, and overmolded and imported cables. BOH operates with no minimum volume requirements, handling orders ranging from a few pieces to thousands per week, and emphasizes quick turnaround and just-in-time delivery.

BOH serves original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), contract manufacturers, and a broad range of technology industries. Its customer base includes companies needing custom interconnect solutions for electronic and electromechanical applications.

The company highlights its factory-direct shipping, ISO 9001:2008 certification, RoHS compliance, and UL registration as key differentiators, along with a commitment to exceeding expectations through competitive pricing, 100% quality guarantee, and incomparable client relations.
